preamble: In Northern Wu varieties the Middle Chinese palatal nasal initial (the 日 initial, Baxter ny-) became the voiced alveolar fricative [z] in many words, as in 然 MC nyen > Shanghainese and Suzhou zø. In other words the z form is a literary reading alongside a colloquial one that keeps [ɲ] (熱 Suzhou literary zəʔ, vernacular n̠ʲiɪʔ). Mandarin shows the parallel outcome ʐ.

examples.to: Shanghainese zən (literary, as in 人民)
examples.note: The colloquial reading gnin keeps the palatal nasal.
The vernacular reading is n̠ʲiɪʔ in Suzhou.
